scope: Post-hoc different-controller comparison on one used seed and 2 s. Pairing by stance ordinal does not guarantee corresponding motions, especially when runs without toe groups are excluded. Joint samples at each trajectory own last-front-contact; these are associations, not causal effects or biological measurements. Stance boundaries merge gaps up to two 1.25 ms substeps; 1e-7 contact threshold; anatomical identity remains unverified.
